plan: The dominant strategy in this auction is to bid your value. This is because, for any other bid, you are either better off bidding your value (if the other bids are lower) or worse off (if the other bids are higher). Since this is round 1, there is no history to learn from. Therefore, I will bid my value of $22.

The dominant strategy in this second-price sealed-bid auction is to bid your true value. This is because you win if and only if your bid is the highest, and you pay the second-highest bid. Bidding less than your value risks losing the auction to someone who values it more, while bidding more than your value risks winning but paying more than the item is worth to you. Therefore, I will bid my value of $34.

The dominant strategy in this second-price sealed-bid auction is to bid your true value. This is because your payoff is (value - second highest bid) if you win, and 0 if you lose. Bidding less than your value risks losing the auction even if your value is higher than the second highest bid. Bidding more than your value risks winning the auction but paying more than the item is worth to you. Therefore, I will bid my value.
